task: Add a new module src/batch.mjs exporting a named function runBatch(tasks, options) with precise partial-failure semantics. tasks is an array of zero-argument functions returning promises or plain values; options is optional with { concurrency = 1 }. Behavior: start tasks in index order with at most `concurrency` in flight; the first failure (a rejection or a synchronous throw from a task) stops any NEW task from starting, but tasks already in flight run to completion and their outcomes are still recorded; runBatch always resolves (it never rejects) with a report { completed, failed, skipped } where completed is [{ index, value }] and failed is [{ index, error }], both sorted by ascending index regardless of settlement order, and skipped is the ascending list of indexes whose tasks were never started; multiple failures are all recorded. Argument validation is synchronous: the call itself throws TypeError if tasks is not an array of functions, and RangeError if concurrency is not a positive integer — before any task starts. Add a test for the new module and verify with the repository test suite.
